field_principles.matched_work_receipts: Shows event order, model calls, prompts, tokens, checker calls, consumer work, and initial heads match.
field_principles.model_file_and_embedded_tokenizer_hashes: Binds model files and embedded GGUF tokenizer hashes.
field_principles.model_weight_change_count: Must be zero because CSL changes external memory only.
field_principles.models_used: Lists only mandated models with authenticated local receipt support.

field_principles.preconditions_checked: Lists every gate checked before readiness can become one.

field_principles.preregistered_frozen_single_path_and_dua: Defines all three arms before labels open.
field_principles.proposal_memory_schema_head_and_transiti: Records proposal-memory updates from exact feasible-action evidence only.
field_principles.protected_leakage_count: Must be zero because protected partitions cannot route writes.

field_principles.raw_event_and_pre_outcome_proposal_freez: Proves raw bytes and proposals froze before outcomes.

field_principles.same_step_write_count: Must be zero because current outcomes cannot influence same-step decisions.
field_principles.selection_memory_schema_head_and_transit: Records selection-memory updates from exact observed consequences only.
